notes.title: DEMO "AstroPlanet"
notes.notes:
THE WHOLE PLANET IS AT YOUR DISPOSAL!

You have damaged your ship and ended up on a planet where the air is unsuitable for breathing. But all is not lost! You will have to use all your skills and intelligence to survive and return to Earth.

BASE CONSTRUCTION
Start with the basics — create a base that will be your refuge on this hostile planet. Develop a strategy to protect and develop your base.

COLLECTING VARIOUS RESOURCES
Resources are your everything on this planet. Get them, manage them wisely and use them to terraform the planet and grow food.

TERRAFORMING THE PLANET
Turn a disastrous landscape into a picturesque paradise! Explore the environment, interact with the ecosystem of the planet and try to transform it into a green and picturesque area.

Dangers and challenges
Besides the fact that you have to fight a hostile environment and counter threats, there are dangers and secrets hiding on the planet. Solve the puzzles to survive.

GROWING FOOD
There are no grocery stores on this planet. You will have to grow your own food and take care of your diet to avoid starvation.
